component.name: Lontar
component.summary: Read your ebooks and keep your place on every device

description.p: Lontar is a simple ebook reader. Point it at the folders where you keep your books, and it shows them as a library you can read from. It remembers where you stopped in every book.

ul.li: Reads EPUB, PDF, Kindle (MOBI, AZW, AZW3), FB2 and comic book (CBZ) files
Search inside a book, or search your library by title or author
Adjustable text size and line spacing, with light, sepia and dark pages
Opens ebooks straight from your file manager

description.p: Your reading place, bookmarks and highlights are kept in a small file next to each book, so a folder synced with a tool such as Syncthing carries them to your other devices. Lontar is also available for Android, macOS, Windows and iOS.
Books with copy protection (DRM) can't be opened.
